Malformed SDF files. Each case starts with a line `=== <name>`; the next
line `error: <line>:<column>: <message>` is the exact error, with positions
counted from the first line after it. The derivation of every case is in
readme.md.
=== empty file
error: 1:1: expected `(` starting the DELAYFILE, found the end of the file
=== not a delay file
error: 1:2: expected `DELAYFILE`, found `DELAYFILES`
(DELAYFILES (SDFVERSION "3.0"))
=== version missing
error: 1:13: the header must start with SDFVERSION, found `DESIGN`
(DELAYFILE (DESIGN "x"))
=== no cell
error: 2:16: the DELAYFILE has no CELL entry (it needs at least one)
(DELAYFILE (SDFVERSION "3.0")
  (DESIGN "tb"))
=== header order
error: 3:4: the header entry DESIGN comes after DIVIDER (the header order is fixed)
(DELAYFILE (SDFVERSION "3.0")
  (DIVIDER /)
  (DESIGN "tb"))
=== header repeated
error: 1:45: the header entry DESIGN repeats DESIGN (the header order is fixed)
(DELAYFILE (SDFVERSION "3.0") (DESIGN "a") (DESIGN "b"))
=== divider
error: 1:40: the hierarchy divider must be `.` or `/`, not `:`
(DELAYFILE (SDFVERSION "3.0") (DIVIDER :))
=== timescale number
error: 1:42: the timescale number must be 1, 10 or 100 (or 1.0, 10.0, 100.0), not `5`
(DELAYFILE (SDFVERSION "3.0") (TIMESCALE 5ns))
=== timescale unit
error: 1:44: the timescale unit must be us, ns or ps, not `fs`
(DELAYFILE (SDFVERSION "3.0") (TIMESCALE 1 fs))
=== unterminated string
error: 1:29: a QSTRING cannot contain a newline (the string is not closed)
(DELAYFILE (SDFVERSION "3.0)
)
=== unclosed cell
error: 4:1: expected a timing specification or `)` closing the CELL, found the end of the file
(DELAYFILE (SDFVERSION "3.0")
  (CELL (CELLTYPE "AND2") (INSTANCE and1)
    (DELAY (ABSOLUTE (IOPATH a y (1))))

=== unclosed delay file
error: 4:1: the file ends before the DELAYFILE is closed
(DELAYFILE (SDFVERSION "3.0")
  (CELL (CELLTYPE "AND2") (INSTANCE and1)
    (DELAY (ABSOLUTE (IOPATH a y (1)))))

=== text after the delay file
error: 4:1: unexpected `)` after the end of the DELAYFILE
(DELAYFILE (SDFVERSION "3.0")
  (CELL (CELLTYPE "AND2") (INSTANCE and1)
    (DELAY (ABSOLUTE (IOPATH a y (1))))))
)
=== missing delay values
error: 3:33: expected the delay values of IOPATH, found `)`
(DELAYFILE (SDFVERSION "3.0")
  (CELL (CELLTYPE "AND2") (INSTANCE and1)
    (DELAY (ABSOLUTE (IOPATH a y)))))
=== misplaced instance
error: 2:28: CELLTYPE must be followed by INSTANCE, found `DELAY`
(DELAYFILE (SDFVERSION "3.0")
  (CELL (CELLTYPE "AND2") (DELAY (ABSOLUTE (IOPATH a y (1))))))
=== number with two points
error: 3:35: `1.2.3` is not a number
(DELAYFILE (SDFVERSION "3.0")
  (CELL (CELLTYPE "AND2") (INSTANCE and1)
    (DELAY (ABSOLUTE (IOPATH a y (1.2.3))))))
=== number out of range
error: 3:35: the number `1e99999` is out of range (exponent beyond 9999)
(DELAYFILE (SDFVERSION "3.0")
  (CELL (CELLTYPE "AND2") (INSTANCE and1)
    (DELAY (ABSOLUTE (IOPATH a y (1e99999))))))
=== number with too many digits
error: 3:35: the number `1234567890123456789012345678901234567890` has more than 18 significant digits
(DELAYFILE (SDFVERSION "3.0")
  (CELL (CELLTYPE "AND2") (INSTANCE and1)
    (DELAY (ABSOLUTE (IOPATH a y (1234567890123456789012345678901234567890))))))
=== triple with one colon
error: 3:35: the triple `1:2` must have exactly two colons
(DELAYFILE (SDFVERSION "3.0")
  (CELL (CELLTYPE "AND2") (INSTANCE and1)
    (DELAY (ABSOLUTE (IOPATH a y (1:2))))))
=== wildcard inside a path
error: 2:36: the instance path `ffs.*`: the wildcard `*` cannot be part of a hierarchical path
(DELAYFILE (SDFVERSION "3.0")
  (CELL (CELLTYPE "DFF") (INSTANCE ffs.*)))
=== malformed bit spec
error: 2:36: the bit spec `[1` of the instance path `ffs[1` is not `[n]` or `[m:n]` with non-negative integers
(DELAYFILE (SDFVERSION "3.0")
  (CELL (CELLTYPE "DFF") (INSTANCE ffs[1)))
=== unbalanced condition
error: 3:33: expected `)` closing the parenthesized condition, found `(`
(DELAYFILE (SDFVERSION "3.0")
  (CELL (CELLTYPE "MUX") (INSTANCE mux1)
    (DELAY (ABSOLUTE (COND ((s) (IOPATH a y (1))))))))
=== RETAIN after the delays
error: 3:39: RETAIN entries must come before the IOPATH delays
(DELAYFILE (SDFVERSION "3.0")
  (CELL (CELLTYPE "AND2") (INSTANCE and1)
    (DELAY (ABSOLUTE (IOPATH a y (5) (RETAIN (1)))))))
=== CCOND before SCOND
error: 3:56: SCOND is out of order or repeated (SCOND comes before CCOND, once each)
(DELAYFILE (SDFVERSION "3.0")
  (CELL (CELLTYPE "DFF") (INSTANCE ff1)
    (TIMINGCHECK (SETUPHOLD d clk (1) (1) (CCOND rst) (SCOND rst)))))
=== unknown edge
error: 3:31: `rise` is not an edge identifier (posedge, negedge, 01, 10, 0z, z1, 1z, z0)
(DELAYFILE (SDFVERSION "3.0")
  (CELL (CELLTYPE "DFF") (INSTANCE ff1)
    (DELAY (ABSOLUTE (IOPATH (rise clk) q (1))))))
=== WAVEFORM edges not alternating
error: 3:50: WAVEFORM edges must alternate between posedge and negedge
(DELAYFILE (SDFVERSION "3.0")
  (CELL (CELLTYPE "tb") (INSTANCE)
    (TIMINGENV (WAVEFORM ff1.clk 10 (posedge 0) (posedge 5)))))
=== non-ASCII text
error: 1:25: the character 0xc3 is not an SDF character (SDF files are ASCII)
(DELAYFILE (SDFVERSION "é3.0"))
=== unknown header entry
error: 1:32: `AUTHOR` is not a header entry
(DELAYFILE (SDFVERSION "3.0") (AUTHOR "me"))
=== unknown delay definition
error: 3:23: expected IOPATH, COND, CONDELSE, PORT, INTERCONNECT or DEVICE, found `PATH`
(DELAYFILE (SDFVERSION "3.0")
  (CELL (CELLTYPE "AND2") (INSTANCE and1)
    (DELAY (ABSOLUTE (PATH a y (1))))))
=== timing check in DELAY
error: 3:23: expected IOPATH, COND, CONDELSE, PORT, INTERCONNECT or DEVICE, found `SETUP`
(DELAYFILE (SDFVERSION "3.0")
  (CELL (CELLTYPE "DFF") (INSTANCE ff1)
    (DELAY (ABSOLUTE (SETUP d clk (1))))))
=== special character in a name
error: 2:36: the character `+` in the instance path `a+b` must be escaped with `\`
(DELAYFILE (SDFVERSION "3.0")
  (CELL (CELLTYPE "DFF") (INSTANCE a+b)))
=== SCOND repeated
error: 3:56: SCOND is out of order or repeated (SCOND comes before CCOND, once each)
(DELAYFILE (SDFVERSION "3.0")
  (CELL (CELLTYPE "DFF") (INSTANCE ff1)
    (TIMINGCHECK (SETUPHOLD d clk (1) (1) (SCOND rst) (SCOND rst)))))
